title: Rename exported function and usage
instruction: Rename function addOne to increment in src/math.ts and update src/index.ts usage. Run the provided node check mentally or with shell.

checks.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const a=fs.readFileSync('src/math.ts','utf8'); const b=fs.readFileSync('src/index.ts','utf8'); if(!a.includes('increment')||!b.includes('increment(1)')) process.exit(1)"
